scope: Spatial candidate comparator evidence; no reproduction; incremental ledger

sources.citation: Turkulainen, M.; Krishnan, A.; Aleotti, F.; Sayed, M.; Garcia-Hernando, G.; Kannala, J.; Solin, A.; Brostow, G.; Turmukhambetov, D. (2026). Cross-View Splatter: Feed-Forward View Synthesis with Georeferenced Images. CVPR, 40959–40970.
sources.status: CVPR2026 proceedings verified in foundation; current author repository citation confirms venue.
sources.reading_depth: Selected full HTML: §§3–4, Tables 2–3, Appendices A, B, G; PDF fetch failed.
sources.method: VGGT/AnySplat backbone; cross-attention fuses ground imagery with orthoimage; predicts a satellite heightmap and Gaussian splats. Confidence-weighted geometry and rendering losses.
sources.evaluation: 10 Tanks and Temples and 40 DL3DV scenes, manually geoaligned; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS, sparse context views. Reported training: four days on two A100 GPUs.
sources.limitation: Appendix G says the approach is unsuitable for underpasses, tunnels and significant overhangs. This is an applicability limitation, not a verified statement about benchmark exclusions. Appearance evaluation does not establish highway deck topology.
sources.access: Repository currently exposes alignment JSON and geoaligner; README says code coming soon. Model/code availability not established; no repository license identified. Manuscript CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 is separate from data rights.

sources.citation: Jiang, L.; Ren, K.; Yu, M.; Xu, L.; Dong, J.; Lu, T.; Zhao, F.; Lin, D.; Dai, B. (2025). Horizon-GS: Unified 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Aerial-to-Ground Scenes. CVPR, 26789–26799.
sources.status: Peer-reviewed CVPR2025; CVF and official repository verified
sources.version: Read arXiv:2412.01745v1, 2 December 2024; not assumed identical to proceedings
sources.reading_depth: Selected full HTML §§3.1–3.3, 5.1–5.3; CVF PDF fetch failed.
sources.method: Aerial-first coarse structure, then frozen coarse primitives and street refinement; balanced densification; 2D Gaussian geometry variant.
sources.evaluation: Eleven aerial/street scenes, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; moving entities and sky masked. Real test views every 32nd image. 2D-GS surface comparison.
sources.limitation: Perspective aerial images differ from orthorectified GIS imagery. Inspected geometric discussion is largely qualitative; no verified grade-separation graph benchmark.
sources.access: Public implementation and setup instructions inspected. Repository directs users to 3D-GS license; full dependencies/data license audit not done.

sources.citation: Yugay, V.; Kersten, T.; Carlone, L.; Gevers, T.; Oswald, M. R.; Schmid, L. (2026). Gaussian Mapping for Evolving Scenes. CVPR, 18903–18912.
sources.reading_depth: Full methods §§4.1–4.3; evaluation §§5–5.2; limitations §6; tables inspected as HTML. PDF fetch failed.
sources.method: Posed RGB-D; depth/color conflicts add/remove Gaussians; SAM/FlashSplat masks entire changed objects and stale keyframe regions.
sources.evaluation: Flat synthetic, two Aria rooms, static TUM-RGBD; every tenth final-sequence frame withheld; all methods use ground-truth poses; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and depth L1.
sources.limitation: No short-term moving objects, primarily external pose tracking, latest state rather than complete change history.
sources.access: Public code, config and data links checked; license file exists but terms not inspected. Repository warns rasterizer nondeterminism. No execution.

sources.citation: Galappaththige, C. J.; Gottwald, T.; Stehr, P.; Heinert, E.; Suenderhauf, N.; Miller, D.; Rottmann, M. (2026). Predictive Photometric Uncertainty in Gaussian Splatting for Novel View Synthesis.
sources.reading_depth: Selected full HTML §§3, 4.1, 4.4; Table 3; Appendix G.
sources.method: Post-hoc per-primitive uncertainty via Bayesian-regularized least squares over residuals; uncertainty attenuates change detections.
sources.evaluation: AUSE/correlation on NVS datasets; PASLCD mIoU/F1 for offline and online change baselines. Online-SCD F1 reported 0.638 to 0.651.
sources.limitation: Photometric uncertainty does not establish calibrated structural-change probability; spatial resolution limited by underlying Gaussians.
sources.access: Manuscript accessible; code/model completeness and license not verified.

sources.citation: Wang, H.; Li, T.; Li, Y.; Chen, L.; Sima, C.; Liu, Z.; Wang, B.; Jia, P.; Wang, Y.; Jiang, S.; Wen, F.; Xu, H.; Luo, P.; Yan, J.; Zhang, W.; Li, H. (2023). OpenLane-V2: A Topology Reasoning Benchmark for Unified 3D HD Mapping. NeurIPS 36, Datasets and Benchmarks.
sources.version: NeurIPS publisher PDF; repository evaluation version warning checked
sources.reading_depth: PDF text pp.6–8 §§4–5, Table 3. Attempted screenshots pp.7–8 failed cache-miss; not visually verified.
sources.method: Directed 3D lane centerlines, traffic elements and graph relations.
sources.evaluation: Fréchet-based lane matching and topology mAP; STSU, VectorMapNet, MapTR, TopoNet compared.
sources.limitation: Already establishes geometry plus topology evaluation. Repository warns v1.0/v1.1 TOP scores differ; do not mix versions.
sources.access: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 dataset, Apache-2.0 code; upstream nuScenes and Argoverse2 terms also apply.

sources.citation: Park, C.; Seo, E.; Hwang, J.; Lim, J. (2025). SC-Lane: Slope-aware and Consistent Road Height Estimation Framework for 3D Lane Detection. ICCV, 28407–28416.
sources.status: Peer-reviewed ICCV2025, CVF indexed proceedings and official repository
sources.version: arXiv:2508.10411v1 identified; read indexed proceedings extracts
sources.reading_depth: Primary indexed paper introduction/method overview and §4.5 Tables4–5 p.28414; direct PDF and venue page fetch failed.
sources.method: Slope-adaptive feature weighting and temporal height consistency supervision.
sources.evaluation: OpenLane lane detection and lidar-derived height errors; ablations separate feature module and consistency.
sources.limitation: Height/topology cannot be claimed wholly new. Full protocol not deeply read; no inference of stacked-deck capability from abstract.
sources.access: Repository indexed README provides checkpoint/data instructions; actual files and licenses not verified.

sources.citation: Parajuli, B.; Roy Choudhury, A.; Kumar, P. (2020). Reconstructing Road Network Graphs from both Aerial Lidar and Images. WACV.
sources.method: Fuse lidar and aerial images for segmentation; disk packing and curve reconstruction yield undirected road graphs.
sources.evaluation: Abstract reports connectivity/topology improvement over thinning; complete protocol not extracted.
sources.limitation: Already combines lidar, imagery and graph reconstruction. Directed lane/deck separation claim needs comparison beyond this abstract.
sources.access: PDF indexed; full-method review and artifact/license checks unresolved.
